name: Get Opportunities
summary: Fetches opportunity records by their external (CRM) ID or Marketo GUID, with optional field selection and paging.
whenToUse: When you have opportunity IDs from Salesforce/Dynamics and want the Marketo-side copy of those records.

query.name: filterType
query.label: Look up by
query.hint: Which ID system the values below are in.

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to return
query.hint: Optional comma-separated field API names (see Get Opportunity Fields). Missing fields come back as null.

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Next page token
query.hint: Optional. Copy nextPageToken from the previous response to continue.

notes: Only String/Integer custom opportunity fields can be used as filter fields.
